method: Recorded compiler/import-significant environment and complete audit snapshots, public-safe path tokens. No all-environment enumeration or full process-environment byte-identity claim.

controlled_environment_sanitized.scope: compiler/import-significant settings; not full process-environment byte identity

environment_scope: Compiler/import-significant settings and frozen runtime objects; not every environment variable or every Lean declaration.
trust_boundary: Official pinned toolchain and Mathlib/package cache remain trusted. Normal project objects were reused only after frozen source, closure and object validation.
privacy: Private account paths and native host nickname omitted. Original receipt/log/archive hashes preserve provenance; redaction-mapping.json documents all projected log changes.
